# RAAS UTSAV 2026 — Jharkhand's Grandest Dandiya Night

> Official festival guide, pass catalog, venue logistics, and policy documentation for AI agents, search engines, and event attendees.

RAAS UTSAV 2026 is an immersive Navratri Dandiya & Garba celebration organized by EVENT POINT (Puja Tent Agency) at Upwan Lawn, Chanakya BNR Hotel, Station Road, Ranchi, Jharkhand on Friday, 16 October 2026 from 5:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST.

## Key Festival Facts
- **Event Date:** 16 October 2026 (Friday)
- **Timing:** 5:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST (Entry gates open at dusk)
- **Venue:** Upwan Lawn, Chanakya BNR Hotel, Station Road, Ranchi, Jharkhand 834001
- **Organizer:** EVENT POINT (Trade Name: PUJA TENT AGENCY)
- **Legal Entity:** Kumari Puja Vishwakarma (Proprietor), GSTIN: `20ARLPV7298K1ZZ`
- **Helpline Phone:** +91 94301 12440 / +91 99315 03960
- **Official Email:** eventpointranchi18@gmail.com
- **Official Website:** https://raasutsav.in

## Ticketing & Booking Rules
- **One Booking = One Pass:** Every pass reservation is an independent booking with its own unique booking reference (e.g., `RU26-REQ-XXXX`) and admission pass.
- **Pay Now vs. Pay Later:** Attendees can pay immediately via Razorpay / PhonePe, or choose "Pay Later" to hold their reservation for 24 hours.
- **24-Hour Hold Lifecycle:** If payment is not completed within 24 hours of booking, the reserved pass is automatically released back to public inventory.
- **Digital Admission QR:** Upon confirmed payment, an unforgeable, cryptographically signed admission QR token is generated on the official receipt for gate scanning. Unpaid or pending bookings have no admission QR.
- **Cancellation Policy:** Cancellations are permitted until October 10, 2026, 11:59 PM IST with an 80% refund (20% fee + GST). Zero refunds apply after this deadline.

## Pass Tiers & Pricing (GST Inclusive)
- [Solo Pass Female (₹999)](https://raasutsav.in/pricing): Single entry pass for female attendee with full festival and food court access.
- [Couple Pass (₹1,999)](https://raasutsav.in/pricing): Entry pass for one couple (two attendees) with main Garba arena access.
- [Family Pass - 4 Pax (₹3,599)](https://raasutsav.in/pricing): Entry pass for up to 4 family members with family seating and photo booth access.
- [Group Pass - 6 Pax (₹4,999)](https://raasutsav.in/pricing): Best-value entry pass for up to 6 attendees (friends/students).
- [VIP Couple Pass (₹3,499)](https://raasutsav.in/pricing): Priority VIP lane entry, reserved elevated seating, and dedicated food service for 2 attendees.
- [VIP Group Pass - 6 Pax (₹7,999)](https://raasutsav.in/pricing): Premium festival experience with VIP lounge access, luxury seating, and complimentary festive snacks for 6 attendees.
